codex_title: Sancti Thomae de Aquino Opera de Scientia Mathematica et Materia Intelligibili
codex_subtitle: Foundational Texts on Mathematical Science, Intelligible Matter, Abstraction, and Judgment
primary_corpus: Corpus Thomisticum (S. Thomae de Aquino Opera Omnia, recognovit Enrique Alarcón, Pompaelone ad Universitatis Studiorum Navarrensis aedes)
license_status: Public Domain (Latin primary texts from critical Leonine, Marietti, and Decker editions; facing English translations combining 1920 English Dominican Fathers public-domain Summa Theologiae with original scholarly translations directly from the verified Latin text)
